parsed.summary: The patch addresses the specific issue but may not handle all edge cases related to adding zero vectors.

issues.description: The patch only checks if the other vector is exactly 0, but it should also handle cases where the other vector is a scalar multiple of a zero vector or a vector with zero components.
The patch does not include any new tests to verify that the addition of zero vectors works correctly in various scenarios.
